case_eligibility: Published CEX endpoint in frozen dataset
Distinct non-zero source wallet not a published or operational VASP endpoint
Observed source-to-endpoint transfer in cached/live GoldRush recent endpoint page
Valid transaction hash, block and timestamp
One candidate per endpoint and source; no duplicate source/transaction
First-pilot source wallets excluded from discovery
ambiguity_rule: If retrieved source evidence contains direct transfers to multiple published or operational VASP entities, retain case as ambiguous and exclude it from conditional single-label accuracy; keep it in attempted and retrieval denominators.
conflict_rule: If independently sourced labels assign different VASP entities to the same endpoint and the conflict cannot be independently resolved from the available evidence, that address is marked ground_truth_conflict and excluded from single-label accuracy metrics. Preserve and report it in all-case accounting.

sampling.endpoint_discovery: Deterministic round-robin by (operational/held-out stratum, entity), per-group seed shuffle; most recent eligible inbound transfer in observed page
sampling.final_selection: If pool <100, stop. If 100-149, select all. If >=150, select exactly 150. Within each stratum, select entity-round-robin by discovery case ID; target 70% operational and 30% held-out, fill any shortage from deterministic round-robin of remaining cases. Do not filter conflicts or outcomes.

implementation.label_quality_missing_policy: Unknown numeric confidence/reliability remains null; preexisting quality cap treats it as zero. No score weight changes.

evaluator.primary_denominator: evaluable operational cases, excluding ambiguous, missing evidence, provider failures and ground-truth conflicts
evaluator.all_case_denominator: all fixed final cases; no replacements
evaluator.nearest_vasp_accuracy: not measurable without unique nearest service truth
evaluator.real_world_negative_metrics: not measured without independently verified negatives
